name: createLocation
description: Adds a location to the map and lists, on behalf of the app.

title.description: The location's name, as the app shows it.

subtitle.description: A short line shown under its name. Leave it out for none.

latitude.description: Where it is on the map, north to south, from -90 to 90.

longitude.description: Where it is on the map, east to west, from -180 to 180.

formattedAddress.description: The full address as the map shows it. Leave it out to use the address.

addressAlias.description: A custom name shown for the address on the map. Leave it out for none.

listImage.description: The picture shown for it in lists, as a list holding one image.

description.description: The location's formatted description, as HTML.

images.description: The pictures shown on its page, in order. Leave it out for none.

categories.description: The categories it belongs to, each by name with a subcategory after an arrow, such as "Food -> Pizza, Drinks". Leave it out for none.

markerType.description: How it is marked on the map. Leave it out to use a pin.

markerImage.description: The picture used as its map marker when the marker type is image, as a list holding one image. Leave it out for none.

markerColor.description: The color of its circle marker, such as rgba(253,35,5,1). Leave it out to use red.

showCategory.description: Whether its categories show on its page. Leave it out to show them.

showOpeningHours.description: Whether its opening hours show. Leave it out to hide them.

showPriceRange.description: Whether its price range shows. Leave it out to hide it.

showStarRating.description: Whether its star rating shows. Leave it out to hide it.

priceRange.description: How pricey it is. Leave it out to use $.

priceCurrency.description: The currency sign shown with its price range. Leave it out to use $.

actionItems.description: The buttons on its page, such as calling it or opening its website, in order. Leave it out for none.

pinned.description: Whether it is pinned to the top of the introduction screen; up to three locations can be. Leave it out to leave it unpinned.

mondayHours.description: When it is open on Mondays, such as "08:00-12:00, 13:00-20:00", or "closed". Leave it out to use 08:00-20:00.

tuesdayHours.description: When it is open on Tuesdays, such as "08:00-12:00, 13:00-20:00", or "closed". Leave it out to use 08:00-20:00.

wednesdayHours.description: When it is open on Wednesdays, such as "08:00-12:00, 13:00-20:00", or "closed". Leave it out to use 08:00-20:00.

thursdayHours.description: When it is open on Thursdays, such as "08:00-12:00, 13:00-20:00", or "closed". Leave it out to use 08:00-20:00.

fridayHours.description: When it is open on Fridays, such as "08:00-12:00, 13:00-20:00", or "closed". Leave it out to use 08:00-20:00.

saturdayHours.description: When it is open on Saturdays, such as "08:00-12:00, 13:00-20:00", or "closed". Leave it out to use 08:00-20:00.

sundayHours.description: When it is open on Sundays, such as "08:00-12:00, 13:00-20:00", or "closed". Leave it out to use 08:00-20:00.

callback.description: Runs when the location is added.

error.description: Why it wasn't added, such as a missing title, a category that doesn't exist or a fourth pinned location.

result.description: The location, as it is now.

subtitle.description: The short line shown under its name, if any.

formattedAddress.description: The full address as the map shows it.

addressAlias.description: The custom name shown for the address, if any.

latitude.description: Where it is on the map, north to south.

longitude.description: Where it is on the map, east to west.

listImage.description: The picture shown for it in lists.

images.description: The pictures on its page, in order.

categories.description: Its categories and subcategories, written the way they are given when adding a location.

markerType.description: How it is marked on the map: pin, circle or image.

markerImage.description: The picture used as its marker, if it has one.

markerColor.description: The color of its circle marker, if it has one.

showCategory.description: Whether its categories show on its page.

priceRange.description: How pricey it is, from 1 ($) to 4 ($$$$).

priceCurrency.description: The currency sign of its price range.

pinned.description: Whether it is pinned to the top of the introduction screen.

pinPosition.description: Its place among the pinned locations, if it is pinned.

openingHours.description: When it is open, day by day.

monday.description: Its hours on Mondays, such as 08:00-20:00, or closed.

tuesday.description: Its hours on Tuesdays, such as 08:00-20:00, or closed.

wednesday.description: Its hours on Wednesdays, such as 08:00-20:00, or closed.

thursday.description: Its hours on Thursdays, such as 08:00-20:00, or closed.

friday.description: Its hours on Fridays, such as 08:00-20:00, or closed.

saturday.description: Its hours on Saturdays, such as 08:00-20:00, or closed.

sunday.description: Its hours on Sundays, such as 08:00-20:00, or closed.

actionItems.description: The buttons on its page, in order.

action.description: What the button does, such as callNumber or linkToWeb.

fieldValues.description: What it holds for each location field.

value.description: What the location holds for the field.

customLabel.description: The location's own label for the field, if it has one.

views.description: How many times it was viewed.
